title: MS Teams Bot Response Templates
description: Standardized response messages for the BMS Agent MS Teams bot

help.title: BMS Agent Bot - Available Commands
help.text:
Ask me questions about railway documentation or use these commands:

/ask [question] - Get direct answers with citations
/search [query] - Search for documents
/upload - Upload a document for indexing
/status [doc_id] - Check document processing status
/history - View your recent searches (7 days)
/admin [action] - Manage access (admins only)
/help - Show this message

Examples:
- What are the emergency brake procedures?
- /search VLAN configuration
- /admin allow #operations-team

query_unclear.text:
I couldn't understand your query. Try being more specific:

✓ Good: "What are emergency brake procedures for Class 395?"
✗ Vague: "Tell me about trains"

✓ Good: "Search for VLAN configuration in safety systems"
✗ Vague: "network stuff"
